text:
拿起一件道具，能和它合成的道具身上会标一枚小锤。拖到其中一件上松手，先看一眼要用掉哪两件、合出什么（没合成过也没见过的成品是问号），按「合成」才合：两件消失，成品落在被压的那件的位置，放不下自动找位。取消就放回原处。棋盘和{zone:地上}的都能合。

锁着的、随身之物不会被合掉。合成只在一局里发生。

texts.en:
Pick up an item and every item it can combine with is marked with a small hammer. Drop it on one of them to see which two items will be used and what they make (a result you have never made or seen shows as a question mark), then press Fuse. Both items disappear and the result lands where the item underneath was; if it doesn't fit, it finds a spot automatically. Cancel puts it back. Items on the board and on the {zone:地上} both count.

Locked and pinned items are never used up. Crafting only happens during a run.
